quiz.title: A few quick questions
quiz.intro: Four taps. If a question doesn't fit you, choose “Not sure”: it's skipped, not counted.
quiz.privacy: Your answers stay in this browser tab.

veins.prompt: Look at the veins on the inside of your wrist. They look…

daylight.prompt: In daylight, does your skin look more…

metal.prompt: Which looks better next to your face?

white.prompt: Which suits you better: pure white or off-white clothing?

summary.title: Your answers
summary.later: Your results will use these answers together with your photo.

depth.mstApprox: About {value} on the Monk Skin Tone scale (approximate)

notes.photoQuizDisagree: Your photo and your answers pointed in different directions, so we're less sure. Both metal families may work for you.
notes.lowPhotoConfidence: The photo gave us limited information, so your answers count for more.
notes.noQuizAnswers: This result is based on your photo only. Answering the questions makes it more reliable.
notes.bothCanWork: Both metal families can work for you, so go with what you love.
notes.bothCanWorkUncertain: Both metal families can work for you. For a clearer result, retake your photo in daylight, hold up a sheet of white paper to calibrate, and answer any questions you skipped.

necklaces.fine-pendant: A fine chain with a small pendant
necklaces.pendant: A pendant on a mid-length chain

finishes.lighter: Fine pieces and brushed or satin finishes look soft on lighter skin. High polish adds sparkle when you want it.
finishes.medium: Most finishes work for you: polished for shine, brushed for a softer look. Fine and bold pieces both suit you.
finishes.deeper: High-polish finishes and bolder pieces stand out beautifully on deeper skin. Fine pieces look lovely layered.

summary.cool: Your skin reads cool in this analysis, so cool, white metals are your easiest match.
summary.neutral-cool: Your skin reads neutral with a slight cool lean: cool metals come first, and warm metals work too.
summary.neutral: Your skin reads neutral, so warm and cool metals both suit you, and mixing them works well.
summary.neutral-warm: Your skin reads neutral with a slight warm lean: warm metals come first, and cool metals work too.
summary.warm: Your skin reads warm in this analysis, so warm, golden metals are your easiest match.
summary.uncertain: We couldn't tell clearly enough whether warm or cool metals suit you better, so we show both side by side.

favoured.best: Matches the way your skin tone leans, so it looks effortless.
favoured.good: Matches your skin tone's lean; a softer choice than your top picks.
favoured.care: From the right metal family for you, but a less usual match. Try it as an accent.

other.best: From the other metal family, and still a great match for you.
other.good: From the other metal family, and still easy to wear with your skin tone.
other.care: A less natural match for your skin tone. Wear it in small doses or mix it with your best metals.

mixed.best: Mixing metals bridges warm and cool, so it suits you well.
mixed.good: Lets you wear your best metals together with the others.
mixed.care: Works best when one of your best metals leads the mix.

balanced.best: Both metal families can work for you, and this is one of the easiest to wear.
balanced.good: Can work for you; a softer choice than the top picks.
balanced.care: A less usual match. Try it as an accent.
